mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TB_PAYMENT_CANCEL_RETRY T USING (SELECT #{paymentKey} AS PAYMENT_KEY FROM DUAL) S ON (T.PAYMENT_KEY = S.PAYMENT_KEY) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( RETRY_ID, PAYMENT_KEY, ORDER_ID, PAY_METHOD, CANCEL_AMOUNT, CANCEL_REASON, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, STATUS_CD, ATTEMPT_CNT, LAST_ERROR, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_TB_PAYMENT_CANCEL_RETRY.NEXTVAL, #{paymentKey}, #{orderId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{payMethod}, #{cancelAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SUBSTRB(#{cancelReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 200), #{idempotencyKey}, 'PENDING', 0, SUBSTRB(#{lastError, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 1000), SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT RETRY_ID, PAYMENT_KEY, ORDER_ID, PAY_METHOD, CANCEL_AMOUNT, CANCEL_REASON, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, STATUS_CD, ATTEMPT_CNT, LAST_ERROR, REG_DATE, PROCESS_DATE FROM TB_PAYMENT_CANCEL_RETRY WHERE STATUS_CD = 'PENDING' ORDER BY RETRY_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PAYMENT_CANCEL_RETRY SET STATUS_CD = 'PROCESSING', PROCESS_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE RETRY_ID = #{retryId} AND STATUS_CD = 'PENDING'
UPDATE TB_PAYMENT_CANCEL_RETRY SET STATUS_CD = 'SUCCESS', PROCESS_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE RETRY_ID = #{retryId} AND STATUS_CD = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE TB_PAYMENT_CANCEL_RETRY SET STATUS_CD = 'PENDING', ATTEMPT_CNT = ATTEMPT_CNT + 1, LAST_ERROR = SUBSTRB(#{lastError, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 1000), PROCESS_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE RETRY_ID = #{retryId} AND STATUS_CD = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE TB_PAYMENT_CANCEL_RETRY SET STATUS_CD = 'FAILED', ATTEMPT_CNT = ATTEMPT_CNT + 1, LAST_ERROR = SUBSTRB(#{lastError, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, 1000), PROCESS_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE RETRY_ID = #{retryId} AND STATUS_CD = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE TB_PAYMENT_CANCEL_RETRY SET STATUS_CD = 'PENDING' WHERE STATUS_CD = 'PROCESSING' AND PROCESS_DATE < SYSDATE - (#{stuckMinutes} / 1440)
